evidence.text:
王濬沖為尚書令著公服乘軺車經黄公酒壚下過
顧謂後車客吾昔與嵇叔
夜阮嗣宗共酣飲於此壚竹林之逰亦預其末自嵇
生夭阮公亡以來便為時所羈紲今日視此雖近邈
若山河

judgment.explanation: 王濬沖 is the courtesy name of 王戎 (Wang Rong), one of the Seven Sages of the Bamboo Grove. The alias registry confirms 王濬沖 as surname plus courtesy name for 王戎. The passage describes him as 尚書令, which matches Wang Rong's historical career.
尚書令 is the office held by 王濬沖 (王戎). The office title refers to the person holding it, which is 王戎. The candidate evidence identifies this office as held by 王戎.

judgment.explanation: 阮公 refers to 阮嗣宗 (阮籍, Ruan Ji), one of the Seven Sages. The alias registry confirms 阮嗣宗 as surname plus courtesy name for 阮籍. The text explicitly coreferences 阮公 with 阮嗣宗 mentioned earlier.

文康 is the personal name of 庾爰之's elder brother, as stated in the Liu annotation. The candidate is a local person form grounded in the annotation text itself. 文康 is the courtesy name of 庾亮 (Yu Liang), and the annotation confirms this person.

潁川庾爰之 is a full name with place of origin mentioned in the Liu annotation. The candidate is a local person form directly grounded in the annotation text, referring to the historical figure 庾爰之 from Yingchuan.

records.explanation: 王濬沖 is the full name of the person who 為 (serves as) 尚書令. He is the speaker in this passage, distinct from 阮嗣宗 and 阮公.
records.referent_role: 王濬沖 (Wang Junzhong), the person holding the office of 尚書令

records.referent_role: 阮公, referring to 阮嗣宗 (阮籍)

records.referent_role: 庾爰之's elder brother named 文康

records.explanation: 潁川庾爰之 is a full name with place of origin. He is the younger brother of 文康 (伯文康). The kinship relation is that 文康 is his elder brother.
records.referent_role: 潁川庾爰之, a person from Yingchuan

records.explanation: 阮嗣宗 is the courtesy name of 阮籍. He is one of the people 王濬沖 used to drink with at the tavern. He corefers with 阮公 later in the text.
records.referent_role: 阮嗣宗 (Ruan Sizong), courtesy name of 阮籍

records.explanation: 後車客 refers collectively to the guests riding in the rear carriage. 王濬沖 turns and speaks (顧謂) to them. They are distinct from 王濬沖 himself.
records.referent_role: the guests in the rear carriage (collective)

records.explanation: 伯文康 is a kinship reference meaning 'elder brother 文康'. The 伯 indicates elder brother relationship to 庾爰之 (潁川庾爰之). 文康 is the name of this elder brother, coreferring with the separate mention 文康.

Since that time, Wang Rong has been constrained/bound by the times (his official duties), describing the intervening period up to the present.

Liu Xiaobiao's annotation notes that the story was unheard of in the Central Court (Western Jin) but suddenly appeared in Jiangzuo (Eastern Jin), providing historical context about the story's provenance.
